description: This file defines a Drupal 7 node source plugin class for migrating nodes from the database, including methods for constructing queries, preparing data rows, and handling translations.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: A Drupal 7 node source plugin class for migrating nodes from the database.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the plugin with configuration, migration, state, entity type manager, and module handler.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the plugin using dependency injection container.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Builds and returns the database query to retrieve node data, including joins and optional language translation fields.

methods.name: prepareRow
methods.description: Prepares each data row by setting source properties, handling translations, and replacing title if needed.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Returns an array describing the fields available in the source data.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Defines the primary key for the source data, which is 'nid'.

methods.name: handleTranslations
methods.description: Modifies the query to include or exclude translations based on configuration.
